func_800370E8_37CE8.title: Prepare Goemon's Impact minigame entry
func_800370E8_37CE8.summary: Saves the current player position and facing, then records native transition values for room 0x01E0.
behavior: Copies the current player XYZ position and facing into native transition state before preparing the minigame entry.
Calls func_801FA4FC_5B640C with room 0x01E0, arrival XYZ (0, 25, 0), camera value 0, and final argument 1. The helper's nonzero branch writes transition marker 4.
The associated File 98 event scenarios are 0x0172 through 0x0175.
cautions: This documents the verified native launch path and its transition-state writes; a generic room transfer is not established as an equivalent replacement.
The saved transition-state fields are not documented here as general-purpose save data.
func_800370E8_37CE8.exampleExplanation: This calls the native launcher, which snapshots the active player's position and prepares the documented room request. It does not demonstrate that an unrelated room-transfer routine recreates this path.

func_08001AE4_718984.title: Prepare Ebisumaru's sweets minigame entry
func_08001AE4_718984.summary: Configures the native transition to room 0x01E1 and queues the common continuation used by the sweets minigame path.
behavior: Calls func_801FA420_5B6330 with room 0x01E1, arrival XYZ (0, 0, 0), camera value 0, setup value 0x50, and final option 0.
Queues scheduler callback 0x800354B4 after preparing the transition state.
The associated File 98 event scenarios are 0x017A and 0x017B. In the one-shot route, save flag 0x007D is cleared before this entry handler is queued.
cautions: The documented behavior is this native start sequence; it does not establish that a generic room transfer reproduces the transition state or scheduler continuation.
Only the observed setup value 0x50 and final option 0 are documented for this route; the full meanings and valid ranges of those fields are not established.
func_08001AE4_718984.exampleExplanation: This invokes the native entry handler. The handler configures the room request and queues the game's continuation callback.

func_801FA4FC_5B640C.title: Record a native room-entry request
func_801FA4FC_5B640C.summary: Stores a room, arrival coordinates, camera value, and marker mode in native transition state.
func_801FA4FC_5B640C.declaration: void func_801FA4FC_5B640C(uint16_t room_id, int16_t x, int16_t y, int16_t z, uint16_t camera, char marker_mode);

parameters.name: room_id
parameters.description: Raw destination room ID. The verified minigame callers use 0x01E0 and 0x01E2.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Raw arrival X value; the verified callers include a negative value.

parameters.name: z
parameters.description: Raw arrival Z value; the verified Sasuke caller uses -357.

parameters.name: camera
parameters.description: Raw camera value supplied by the caller; the verified calls use 0 and 0x0060.

parameters.name: marker_mode
parameters.description: A zero value stores marker 1; a nonzero value stores marker 4. Broader marker semantics are not established here.

behavior: Stores the five 16-bit request values in native transition state, then selects marker 1 for a zero marker_mode or marker 4 for any nonzero marker_mode.
The Goemon and Sasuke minigame launchers call this helper with marker_mode 1 after saving the current player position and facing.
cautions: This helper records transition state; its implementation alone does not establish a complete room transfer or the lifecycle that consumes the fields.
Use the exact values and surrounding native sequence verified for the intended launcher. Do not treat this call as a generic teleport API.
func_801FA4FC_5B640C.exampleExplanation: This reproduces the helper's observed field values only. The native Sasuke launcher also snapshots the current player position and facing before making this call.

func_801FA420_5B6330.title: Prepare an extended native room-entry request
func_801FA420_5B6330.summary: Records native room-entry state plus setup and option values, then selects final transition marker 9.
func_801FA420_5B6330.declaration: void func_801FA420_5B6330(uint16_t room_id, int16_t x, int16_t y, int16_t z, uint16_t camera, uint32_t setup_value, uint16_t option);

parameters.name: room_id
parameters.description: Raw destination room ID. The sweets challenge entry supplies 0x01E1; its native exit supplies 0x016D.

parameters.name: camera
parameters.description: Raw camera value. The sweets challenge entry supplies 0; its exit supplies 0x0100.

parameters.name: setup_value
parameters.description: Stored in an additional native transition field. The sweets challenge entry supplies 0x50 and its exit supplies 0xA0; the full semantic range is not established.

parameters.name: option
parameters.description: Stored in another transition field. The verified Ebisumaru caller supplies 0; broader semantics are not established.

behavior: Forwards the room, XYZ, and camera values to func_801FA4FC_5B640C with marker_mode 0, which selects marker 1.

Stores setup_value and option in additional native transition fields, then ORs 0x08 into the same marker byte at system +0x3AE29 that the inner helper set to 1. The wrapper therefore finishes with marker 9.
The verified Ebisumaru entry supplies room 0x01E1, XYZ (0, 0, 0), camera 0, setup value 0x50, and option 0; its caller then queues scheduler callback 0x800354B4.
The sweets challenge exit calls this helper after restoring its saved 48-byte statistics block, using room 0x016D, XYZ (0,7,1), camera 0x0100, setup 0xA0 and option 0.

One native camera-initialization path uses a nonzero setup word independently of marker bit 0x08; another path reads that bit together with the setup word and option halfword. These fields are part of the surrounding room/camera lifecycle.
cautions: This helper prepares native state but does not queue the scheduler callback itself.
The semantic meanings and valid ranges of setup_value and option are not established beyond the observed sweets challenge entry and exit calls.
The basic destination setter and saved-history request helper do not establish this same setup/option contract. Preserve the fields required by the verified native entry or exit path.
func_801FA420_5B6330.exampleExplanation: The separate native entry handler queues scheduler callback 0x800354B4 after preparing these fields. This helper call by itself does not reproduce that surrounding lifecycle.
